animals.name: Neocaridina shrimp
animals.notes: 18 shrimp across both tanks - a small population. Investigate any death.

animals.name: Fancy guppy
animals.notes: Sex ratio unknown. If mixed, fry within weeks and a compounding bioload in a tank with no nitrate export.

animals.name: Suckermouth catfish
animals.notes: Otocinclus or juvenile pleco - not established which. Alone, and Otocinclus are shoaling animals needing 5-6+. A common pleco reaches 30 cm and would outgrow this tank entirely. The belly check is the only health signal available.

animals.name: Albino mystery snail
animals.notes: Adults are commonly given 2.5-5 gal each. Three of them in a shared four gallons is the core of the overstocking problem.

animals.name: Red Racer nerite
animals.notes: Grazes biofilm only. The tank is planted, so there is real grazing surface, but a young setup carries thin biofilm for six grazers plus nine shrimp.

animals.name: Neocaridina shrimp
animals.notes: Nine animals on a 3-4 week molt clock in the tank with the lowest GH.
